thread:
kate-growth: Quick kickoff — Marketplace Launch Sprint for the StratusHub + Lakefront integration. Goal: joint webinar (tech demo + 10m benchmark), marketplace listing amplification, and a short benchmark narrative for the blog. Need date, host, lead-routing schema, and asset owners today. :mag_right:

alex-growth: Prefer a webinar that's 30m demo + 15m Q&A, with a 7-10m benchmark slide. May 18 or May 25 are my picks. Also want a short social thread + 2 blog variants (technical + customer-facing).

sam-devrel: I can handle the demo and a minimal repro. Need final model variant, sample prompts, and an integration test VM. ETA for bench numbers: 4 business days after I get those. Also: include a demo_request checkbox in the form so we can triage.

peggy-design: Assets we need: hero banner (1200x628), two social tiles (1:1 and 16:9), co-branded slide master (Google Slides), and an alt-texted screenshot for accessibility. Will need logos as SVGs.

oliver-partnerships: Lead-routing constraints from partners: leads must appear in both SFDCs, with hashed email until legal sign-off. Proposed mapping: partner_code param -> webhook route. Example mapping snippet: `partner_code=STRATUS -> https://hooks.redwood.com/partners/stratus` and `partner_code=LAKEFRONT -> https://hooks.redwood.com/partners/lakefront`. Payload keys: email_hash, company, role, interest_tags, utm_source, utm_campaign, demo_request.

kate-growth: OK. Canonical UTMs: `utm_source=partner&utm_medium=marketplace&utm_campaign=marketplace_launch_may2026`. partner_code values: STRATUS / LAKEFRONT. We'll capture email (raw but hashed before webhook), name, company, role, product_interest (checkboxes), and demo_request=true/false. Route hook + cc inbound-marketing@redwood.com.

lena-stratus: May 18 works for StratusHub. We'll provide SVG logo, one-pager, and marketplace listing link by EOD. Partner_code: STRATUS.

tom-lakefront: Lakefront also OK for May 18. We'll share listing URL and a short customer quote for the blog. partner_code=LAKEFRONT.

nate-analytics: Small ask: include a hidden field `lead_source_detail=marketplace_listing` so we can dedupe across partners. Also log a `referrer` and `landing_ts` timestamp in registration payload. For reporting, we'll need p50/p95 latency and cost delta from devrel for the benchmark slide.

sam-devrel: Bench note: early numbers show ~26% median cost reduction when routing to quantized variants + prefix cache on our sample corpus. I'll produce a 1-slide table with p50/p95 latency and cost delta across three prompt buckets (short/med/long). Will post JSON results and a reproducible `curl` snippet to #eng-bench.

peggy-design: Timeline check — need final logos by Apr 22, copy by Apr 24, final deck by Apr 28. Can we lock assets deadlines?

kate-growth: Locking May 18. Timeline: logos Apr 22, copy Apr 24, decks & hero Apr 28, rehearsal week of May 11. Owners: Alex -> webinar copy + social; Sam -> demo & bench artifacts; Peggy -> creative; Oliver -> partner ops & webhook creds; Kate -> event page + landing.

oliver-partnerships: Legal reminder: only hashed email in webhook until MOU. We'll add privacy blurb on landing page: "We share only hashed contact info with partners until agreement is finalized." Also I'll send webhook credentials to internal partnerops by Apr 20.

deploy-bot: Calendar event created: Marketplace Launch Sprint — Redwood x StratusHub x Lakefront — May 18, 2026 — owner: kate-growth. https://cal.example/ev/marketplace-may18 :white_check_mark:

kate-growth: Blockers? If none, I'll create the registration form schema and post here (fields + example payload) so engineering can wire the webhook.

alex-growth: No blockers. I'll draft the customer-facing blog angle and a technical appendix for the benchmark.

sam-devrel: I'll upload bench artifacts and the `curl` example to this thread when ready. Also filing DEVREL-618 for the model/prompt work.

kate-growth: Thanks all — I'll post the registration schema in the channel by EOD. :rocket:
